headings.instructions: Use for large stats, action buttons, and phase indicators. High impact. Tracking tight.

body.instructions: Use for readable data, hand history, labels. Clear, geometric legibility.

mono.instructions: Use for hand ranges, percentages, chip amounts, and exact statistics.

surface_styles.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 with 1px border-white/10 for modals, immediate feedback overlays, and sticky HUDs.
surface_styles.neumorphism: Not recommended for this archetype. Stick to sharp, flat, high-contrast panels.
surface_styles.grid_borders: Use border-collapse with border-r border-b border-border/40 for the Stats Dashboard and hand history lists.

main_training_screen.structure: Top: Tournament HUD. Center: Poker Table Canvas. Bottom: Hero Cards & Massive Action Buttons.
main_training_screen.instructions: The table should take up 50-60vh on mobile, leaving ample room for thumb-reachable action buttons. Desktop can use a 2-column split (Table vs Dashboard/History).

stats_dashboard.instructions: Metrics like Overall Accuracy and Streaks should span larger columns. Use large typography for numbers. Use the 'Tracing Beam' surface strategy for key metric cards.

poker_table.instructions: Do not use a literal wood/green felt image. Use a CSS rounded-full (oval) container with a deep dark gradient and a glowing 1px inner border. Seats are absolute positioned items around the oval.

playing_card.style: Pure white background, sharp text, massive center suit icon. Red for hearts/diamonds (#EF4444), Black for spades/clubs (#0F1115).
playing_card.layout: w-16 h-24 or w-24 h-36 for Hero. Subtle shadow. Border radius sm.

action_button.style: Massive touch targets. p-6 or p-8. Uppercase, tight tracking, font-bold.
action_button.layout: Flex or Grid arrangement at the bottom of the screen.

chip_stack.style: Tactical visualization. Minimal flat circular tokens with high-contrast mono font showing the BB amount. Use layered box-shadows to simulate stacks without heavy 3D.

feedback_overlay.style: Center-screen glassmorphism panel. Huge icon (Check/X). Breakdown of action frequencies (e.g. Call 80%, Fold 20%).
feedback_overlay.layout: absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center z-50.

hud_progress.style: Minimalist progress bar at top of screen.
hud_progress.layout: Displays Blind Level, Remaining Players (500 -> 9), and Phase (Early/Mid/Bubble/Final Table).

motion.cards: Slide in from center/dealer and flip. Use Framer Motion layoutId for smooth hand transitions.
motion.chips: Slide from player seat to pot center.
motion.feedback: Scale-in pop with spring physics (stiffness: 300, damping: 20).
motion.progress_bar: Smooth width transition for tournament blind levels.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text, especially card suits and chip numbers, pass APCA or WCAG 4.5:1 against their backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: All action buttons must have a high-contrast focus ring (e.g., ring-2 ring-offset-2 ring-offset-[#050505] ring-white).
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for card dealing animations.

image_urls.description: Scattered dark poker chips. Use for subtle background textures or landing page hero if heavily darkened with a black/80 overlay.

libraries.charts: recharts for the stats dashboard (e.g., accuracy over time line chart, position accuracy radar/bar chart).
libraries.motion: framer-motion for card dealing, chips movement, and immediate feedback popups.

instructions_to_main_agent: You MUST use Barlow Condensed for major headings and numbers, and IBM Plex Sans for body text.
DO NOT use a literal casino green table. Use a deep tactical gradient oval with precise grid layouts for seats.
Action Buttons must be massive, occupying the bottom of the screen. Think 'Command Center', not 'Browser Game'.
Use data-testid on every interactive element (e.g., data-testid='action-btn-fold').
For cards, ensure they are high legibility playing cards. Red suits = #EF4444, Black suits = #0A0A0A (on white card backgrounds).
The feedback overlay must use glassmorphism with high contrast correctly colored text for the specific action breakdown.
Stats dashboard uses strict F-Pattern layout. Emphasize the North Star Metric (e.g., Overall Preflop Accuracy %).
Include an Admin view tailored for JSON range uploads and hand review list.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients (except for the table canvas).
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use F-Pattern or Bento grids.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
